limitations: Descriptive post-results diagnosis; no new forecast, candidate scoring, tuning or production activation.
Reported-only subset results change sample composition and are not estimates of the causal effect of imputation. Corrected reported values remain distinct from directly reported values.

Origin-2010 cohorts exclude schools already missing/reclassified before origin; future attrition is retained in status and complete-window counts. Revised source vintages are not original publication vintages.
Sector centering uses origin-known training identities only. Withheld identities affect diagnostics, never common means.
Disjoint transition windows share boundary price levels; measurement revisions can induce cross-window dependence. Covariance/correlation does not uniquely identify persistent latent school effects.
Schools, residency sectors and overlapping outcome cases share economic years. Institution counts do not create independent macro histories; no confidence or promotion guarantee is assigned.
